text:
Andre (Procurement): Heads up — Carrier-NL reports 12 H100 replacement units held at AMS (Schiphol) pending customs paperwork. Need decision on whether to reconsign from FRA spare pool or push vendor-corrected docs.
Mia (Logistics): Got it. Who is holding exactly? we have 4 spares in FRA ready to ship if we decide reconsign. Link to manifest?
Carrier-NL (ForwarderBot): ForwarderBot: AWB 5NL-AMS-H100 is currently on hold. Reason: missing commercial invoice + HS code mismatch (8703 vs 8471 flagged). Can accept reconsignment to FRA hub but addl handling ~36-48h.
Liza (Vendor Ops): Vendor says they can issue a corrected commercial invoice today and update HS code to 8471. If we go reconsign+air next-day, estimated expedite charge ~+$4,000 (total).
Jordan (Infra): Cluster impact note: losing those 12 H100s reduces eu-west-1 prod pool by ~25% for the next wave — batch jobs will back up. Need temporary loaners or realloc if this stretches multiple days.
Andre (Procurement): @Finance (Emma) can we pre-approve up to $5k for emergency expedite if vendor can't clear AMS? Otherwise prefer vendor-corrected invoice to avoid extra cost.
Finance (Emma): We can approve up to $3k via emergency charge. Anything >$3k needs a PO amendment (will take ~2 business hours). Send final estimate and cost code.
Mia (Logistics): If vendor uploads corrected invoice we may clear customs in AMS and avoid reconsign. Liza — pls chase vendor docs + photos (serial proof) for customs and depot.
Liza (Vendor Ops): On it. Vendor says docs by EOD CET. Also asking: are we okay with depot pickup in AMS? Depot fee €150/unit if we do local pickup.
Carrier-NL (ForwarderBot): If depot pickup requested, will require signed release authorization form (IATF). Sample: `RELEASE_FORM_AMS.pdf` — will attach in ticket.
Jordan (Infra): FYI: reconsign route FRA->AMS may require ops peering change for egress to FRA cluster; ops-team heads up in case of network ACL updates.
Mia (Logistics): Need serial list so customs can match. Liza paste them here when you have.
Liza (Vendor Ops): Serials: H100-TR-1001, H100-TR-1002, H100-TR-1003, H100-TR-1004, H100-TR-1005, H100-TR-1006, H100-TR-1007, H100-TR-1008, H100-TR-1009, H100-TR-1010, H100-TR-1011, H100-TR-1012.
Andre (Procurement): Decision proposal: wait for vendor-corrected invoice first. If not uploaded by 18:00 CET, approve reconsign + air expedite up to $4.5k. Mia/Liza coordinate AWB readiness and confirm handling costs.
Mia (Logistics): :thumbsup: I'll stage FRA AWB and transport docs so we can flip immediately if needed. Carrier-NL, hold movement until explicit go from us (hold until 18:00 CET).
Carrier-NL (ForwarderBot): Confirmed — hold placed on AWB 5NL-AMS-H100. No movement without explicit authorization.
Finance (Emma): Noted. If we go reconsign route, please attach vendor invoice showing expedite charge; we'll route emergency PO change but need that artifact.
Jordan (Infra): Action item for infra: if reconsign happens, update Fleet Allocation sheet and trigger soft-evict schedule to free capacity for higher-priority workloads. I can do the evict but need confirmation.
Mia (Logistics): Also need customs broker contact for AMS clearance — @Liza share broker details when available.
Liza (Vendor Ops): Broker: NL-Broker BV <broker@nl-broker.example.com>. Vendor expects to send corrected invoice within ~3 hours.
Carrier-NL (ForwarderBot): Update 15:12 CET: vendor has uploaded corrected commercial invoice and updated HS code. Clearing initiated with AMS customs broker. ETA for clearance and release ~4-6 hours depending on inspection.
Andre (Procurement): Perfect — keep spare-transfer on standby. If customs drags beyond 6 hours we'll revisit expedite. Thanks all for quick coordination.
